<a name="New"></a>
## func [New](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/logger/logger.go#L22>)

```go [logger.go]
func New(filePath string) contracts.Logger
```

New creates a new SlogLogger that writes to the specified file. On failure it discards all log output rather than falling back to os.Stderr, which would corrupt TUI rendering.
